1: """Text and CSV reports."""
2: 
3: from __future__ import annotations
4: 
5: import csv
6: import io
7: from collections.abc import Iterable
8: 
9: from shop.catalog import Catalog
10: from shop.inventory import Inventory
11: from shop.money import format_cents
12: from shop.orders import Order
13: 
14: 
15: def order_summary(order: Order) -> str:
16:     lines = [f"Order #{order.id} [{order.status}]"]
17:     for line in order.lines:
18:         lines.append(
19:             f"  {line.qty} x {line.name} @ {format_cents(line.unit_price_cents)}"
20:             f" = {format_cents(line.line_total_cents)}"
21:         )
22:     t = order.totals
23:     lines.append(f"  Subtotal: {format_cents(t.subtotal_cents)}")
24:     if t.discount_cents:
25:         lines.append(f"  Discount: -{format_cents(t.discount_cents)}")
26:     lines.append(f"  Tax: {format_cents(t.tax_cents)}")
27:     lines.append(f"  Shipping: {format_cents(t.shipping_cents)}")
28:     lines.append(f"  Total: {format_cents(t.total_cents)}")
29:     return "\n".join(lines)
30: 
31: 
32: def sales_by_category(orders: Iterable[Order]) -> dict[str, int]:
33:     """Line totals in cents per category, summed over ``orders``."""
34:     sales: dict[str, int] = {}
35:     for order in orders:
36:         for line in order.lines:
37:             sales[line.category] = sales.get(line.category, 0) + line.line_total_cents
38:     return dict(sorted(sales.items()))
39: 
40: 
41: def top_products(orders: Iterable[Order], n: int = 3) -> list[tuple[str, int]]:
42:     """The ``n`` best-selling SKUs by units, ignoring cancelled orders."""
43:     units: dict[str, int] = {}
44:     for order in orders:
45:         if order.status == "cancelled":
46:             continue
47:         for line in order.lines:
48:             units[line.sku] = units.get(line.sku, 0) + line.qty
49:     ranked = sorted(units.items(), key=lambda kv: (-kv[1], kv[0]))
50:     return ranked[:n]
51: 
52: 
53: def inventory_report(inventory: Inventory, catalog: Catalog) -> str:
54:     rows = ["SKU    Name        Qty"]
55:     for product in catalog:
56:         rows.append(f"{product.sku:<6} {product.name:<11} {inventory.stock(product.sku):>3}")
57:     return "\n".join(rows)
58: 
59: 
60: def orders_to_csv(orders: Iterable[Order]) -> str:
61:     """One row per order line. Amounts are plain decimals (no symbol) so tools can parse them."""
62:     out = io.StringIO()
63:     writer = csv.writer(out, lineterminator="\n")
64:     writer.writerow(["order_id", "status", "sku", "qty", "unit_price", "line_total"])
65:     for order in orders:
66:         for line in order.lines:
67:             writer.writerow(
68:                 [
69:                     order.id,
70:                     order.status,
71:                     line.sku,
72:                     line.qty,
73:                     format_cents(line.unit_price_cents, symbol=""),
74:                     format_cents(line.line_total_cents, symbol=""),
75:                 ]
76:             )
77:     return out.getvalue()

1: """Placing and cancelling orders against a catalog and an inventory."""
2: 
3: from __future__ import annotations
4: 
5: from collections.abc import Mapping
6: from dataclasses import dataclass, field
7: 
8: from shop import pricing
9: from shop.catalog import Catalog
10: from shop.errors import InvalidOrderError, OutOfStockError
11: from shop.inventory import Inventory
12: 
13: 
14: @dataclass(frozen=True)
15: class OrderLine:
16:     sku: str
17:     name: str
18:     unit_price_cents: int
19:     qty: int
20:     category: str
21:     taxable: bool
22:     weight_g: int
23: 
24:     @property
25:     def line_total_cents(self) -> int:
26:         return pricing.line_total(self.unit_price_cents, self.qty)
27: 
28: 
29: @dataclass
30: class Order:
31:     id: int
32:     lines: list[OrderLine]
33:     coupon: str | None
34:     totals: pricing.Totals
35:     status: str = field(default="placed")  # "placed" or "cancelled"
36: 
37: 
38: class OrderBook:
39:     def __init__(self, catalog: Catalog, inventory: Inventory) -> None:
40:         self._catalog = catalog
41:         self._inventory = inventory
42:         self._orders: dict[int, Order] = {}
43:         self._next_id = 1
44: 
45:     def place_order(self, items: Mapping[str, int], coupon: str | None = None) -> Order:
46:         """Reserve stock for ``items`` (sku -> qty) and record the order.
47: 
48:         Either every line is fulfilled or nothing changes.
49:         """
50:         if not items:
51:             raise InvalidOrderError("order has no items")
52:         for sku, qty in items.items():
53:             if not isinstance(qty, int) or qty <= 0:
54:                 raise InvalidOrderError(f"bad quantity for {sku}: {qty!r}")
55:         lines = []
56:         for sku in sorted(items):
57:             product = self._catalog.get(sku)
58:             lines.append(
59:                 OrderLine(
60:                     sku=sku,
61:                     name=product.name,
62:                     unit_price_cents=product.price_cents,
63:                     qty=items[sku],
64:                     category=product.category,
65:                     taxable=product.taxable,
66:                     weight_g=product.weight_g,
67:                 )
68:             )
69:         totals = pricing.price_lines(lines, coupon)  # validates the coupon before stock moves
70:         for line in lines:
71:             if not self._inventory.can_fulfill(line.sku, line.qty):
72:                 raise OutOfStockError(f"{line.sku}: need {line.qty}")
73:         for line in lines:
74:             self._inventory.remove_stock(line.sku, line.qty)
75:         order = Order(id=self._next_id, lines=lines, coupon=coupon, totals=totals)
76:         self._orders[order.id] = order
77:         self._next_id += 1
78:         return order
79: 
80:     def get(self, order_id: int) -> Order:
81:         try:
82:             return self._orders[order_id]
83:         except KeyError:
84:             raise InvalidOrderError(f"unknown order {order_id}") from None
85: 
86:     def cancel(self, order_id: int) -> Order:
87:         order = self.get(order_id)
88:         if order.status != "placed":
89:             raise InvalidOrderError(f"order {order_id} is {order.status}")
90:         for line in order.lines:
91:             self._inventory.add_stock(line.sku, line.qty)
92:         order.status = "cancelled"
93:         return order
94: 
95:     def orders(self, status: str | None = None) -> list[Order]:
96:         found = [o for o in self._orders.values() if status is None or o.status == status]
97:         return sorted(found, key=lambda o: o.id)

    keep = book.place_order({"W-1": 2})
